name: Beat Weaver
description:
About This Game

3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

⬡⬢ Master the multi-track gameplay ⬢⬡

Play sequences of notes to add instruments to the mix one by one. Each vitalized track drains some of the energy that you charge by staying in the flow. Can you keep the record spinning without your energy running out?

⬡⬢ Remix music in motion ⬢⬡

Each journey through a song creates a unique mix driven by your choices. Improvise new routes and string together perfect combos. Fling yourself across tracks or dare to perform multiple instruments simultaneously.

The note highway can twist and be reshuffled in 3D space. Internalize each song's elements to keep your bearings while tracks intertwine around you.

⬡⬢ Bend time and space ⬢⬡

Charge your energy to trigger powerful effects like Slowdown, Rewind and many more to perform crazy maneuvers or simply give your fingers a moment to breathe.

⬡⬢ Handcrafted harmonies ⬢⬡

Groove to a vibrant, eclectic soundtrack (made by humans, not machines) composed & selected for a never before seen synergy between music and gameplay.

⬡⬢ More Features ⬢⬡

  • Musicians rejoice: Add your own songs

    Turn your own music into playable songs by exporting and charting each individual track in the mix.

  • Customizable controls

    Rock out with a gamepad or tap away on your keyboard.

  • Difficulty levels that are right for you 

    Choose between a laid-back music experience and frenetic, hardcore button mashing.

  • Classic high-score mode included

    Rack up points, achieve astronomical scores and discover routes with the best risk-reward balance.

  • Key sounds are back in fashion
    Using a custom built engine with minimal input-to-audio latency, your button presses directly play the corresponding sounds, whether you hit the right note on time or the wrong one too early.
